description: Parent ticket bundling four security findings from a manual audit. Each child is independently fixable; close children individually, then close this parent. Findings reported by user; severity descending: auth bypass on deleted users (#1), cross-user session injection (#2), missing rate limiting (#3), Stripe webhook trusts unpaid completions (#4).

resolution.note: All four security findings landed: requireUser filters soft-deleted users (d6c86b0c), Stripe webhook gates on payment_status='paid' (abf8d253), /api/query verifies session ownership before any work (ec521e21), and /api/query + /api/checkout are now rate-limited via pg-backed UPSERT (72a372d5). Migration 005_rate_limits.sql ships with this PR — must be applied in prod before deploy. Webhook rate-limiting deferred (signature+replay covers them).
